description: HP-18 is the Regional Transport Office code for the Nahan sub-division in the Sirmaur district of Himachal Pradesh. Operating as a Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) under the Sub Divisional Magistrate, it handles driver licensing, vehicle registration, and enforcement of transport regulations for the area.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Nahan, District Sirmaur, Himachal Pradesh
